_comment: Structural deltas between packages/payload/raw/ and raw/payload.json.file_integrity. Modifying raw/ is out of scope for the @szl-holdings/payload package work (task #4930); these deltas pre-date package formalization. Each entry MUST cite why it cannot be reconciled. The strict verify script (scripts/verify-integrity.mjs) accepts only the keys listed here, and only when invoked with --accept-known-deltas / ACCEPT_KNOWN_DELTAS=1.

rationales.README.md: Bundle-level readme added by handoff after payload.json was sealed; not part of the verified payload tree.
rationales._files/thesis/arxiv_pkg/arxiv_submission: Generated artifact (zipped from arxiv_pkg/ contents) that post-dates the manifest; the manifest enumerates the unzipped source files individually.
rationales._critical_findings.json: Excluded from the public bundle by ingestion_policy=PUBLIC_ONLY; remains in the manifest for the private mirror. The public payload exposes the same data via master.critical_findings.
